title: Adityapur-Jamshedpur Machine Knowledge — Diagnostic Evidence Foundation
rule: L4 defines diagnostic questions and evidence gates. A diagnostic may only become active when its required evidence, quality and context conditions are satisfied.

energy.question: Is the asset consuming materially more energy than comparable operation?
energy.rule: Flag only when normalized deviation exceeds the configured significance threshold and is larger than relevant uncertainty.

rotating_condition.question: Has rotating-equipment behaviour changed materially?
rotating_condition.rule: A vibration anomaly is an observation requiring investigation; it is not automatically a bearing, alignment or lubrication diagnosis.

pump.question: Has hydraulic performance changed?
pump.rule: Require a comparable operating point before interpreting efficiency or performance deterioration.

compressed_air.question: Is compressed-air generation or demand behaving abnormally?
compressed_air.rule: Leakage remains a hypothesis unless demand-side or system-level evidence supports it.

thermal.question: Has thermal process efficiency or stability changed?
thermal.rule: Separate startup, soak, production and shutdown states before comparison.

forming.question: Has forming behaviour changed for comparable work?
forming.rule: Do not infer tooling failure from power or force alone.

machining.question: Has machining energy or cycle behaviour changed under comparable cutting conditions?
machining.rule: Energy deviation alone cannot identify tool wear, spindle condition or mechanical fault.

electrical.question: Has electrical loading or power quality changed materially?
electrical.rule: Distinguish supply-side abnormalities from asset-side abnormalities before attribution.

generator.question: Has generation efficiency or output behaviour changed?
generator.rule: Require comparable load conditions before efficiency comparison.

material_handling.question: Has lifting/transport energy or duty behaviour changed?
material_handling.rule: Safety-critical mechanical conclusions require qualified inspection.

measurement_integrity.question: Can the measurement itself be trusted?
measurement_integrity.rule: Measurement-integrity findings take precedence over machine-performance conclusions.

action_policy.safety: Physical electrical/mechanical intervention must follow site procedures and qualified personnel requirements.
action_policy.confidence: Recommendations must not be phrased as confirmed failure unless evidence directly supports the conclusion.

threshold_policy.default_behavior: No universal percentage threshold authorizes a machine fault. Use reference deviation, uncertainty, repeatability, context and diagnostic-specific evidence.

financial_linkage.allowed: Observed or estimated economic impact may be calculated from traceable inputs.
financial_linkage.blocked: Potential or verified savings cannot be presented as verified without intervention and M&V evidence.
